lines.english: "Hmm, I guess it's a tiny bit different from what I expected."
"Oh, what's this? Is Tomo out of all people experiencing new job angst?"
"Did something happen at work?"
"How should I put it… It feels like they're taking me lightly. Makes me wonder if I'm even needed, you know."
"Uwah, I can totally relate! It feels like I'm looking at myself from a year ago."
"Well, you'll always find something different than what you expected in the beginning.
"That's true I guess. The larger the scope, the longer the learning period. I'd say that Tomo's line of work would take a year or so."
"Right now is the time to learn. If you just keep doing your best, you'll get the hang of it…
Though, I guess second-years like ourselves have no right to say that."
"I'm not talking about abstract stuff like that. There are more specific things I'm unhappy about."
"Such as?"
"Such as the mixer just the other day.
"…Huh?"
"…Hey!"
"I couldn't be more disappointed! And to think they wanted to split the bill at such a cheap place.
"I can't say I do…"
"T-This is idiotic."
"What do you mean idiotic? Connections are everything in this industry. I wonder if those guys even see us as valuable assets."
"H-Haha…"
"I'll admit you're optimistic, but you're so gross I can't even bring myself to respond…"
"Hey, that's rude! Besides, wasn't today supposed to be all about encouraging me? Your treat, of course."
"What are you on about? Your salary is higher than anyone else's here. We're obviously relying on your first paycheck to foot the bill."
"Huh!? But my first paycheck was nothing special at all."
"It's okay, you have all the potential in the world, Tomo."
"For sure. I bet she'll overtake me in a single year."
"By then she'll be completely independent with 100 millions of yen in her bank account, I'm sure."
"Yeah, that's the plan, but it's a difficult journey there. Next time I get bullied by a senior newscaster out of jealousy, you two better console me, okay?"
"Oh yeah, as long as you can keep that arrogance up I'm sure you'll be fine. Alright, let's give a toast to Tomo-san's ever growing carnivorous nature!"
"Cheers!"
"Cheers!
…But I'm still poor for now, so you two will cover the bill, won't you?"
"…Tsk, I was so close to having her."
"Oh all right, leave it to us. But in exchange, you'll use your first paycheck to buy a nice little present for your parents."
"Huh, why in god's name would I do that? Not every household is like yours, Setsuna."
"What's with that attitude!? Tomo, take a seat right there!"
"I've been sitting this whole time."
"I meant sitting on your knees, on the floor! To begin with, who do you think is to thank for your life free of wants or inconveniences?"
"Uwah… Save me, Mizusawa-sa…!"
"Excuse me! I'll have a sweet potato shochu!"
Spring has arrived, and the beginning of our second year has slowly become the routine of our second year.
Compared to last year, our lives have changed somewhat; we've become a bit more dependable, and we're a bit fewer in number…
"A-Aah!?"
"Damn it! This is my 19th loss in a row…
Hey Haruki, try showing some restraint, would you!?"
"You're just not any good at fighting games, Takeya. Actually, have you ever played one before?"
"No, you're just too good. And here I was thinking I'd go easy on you out of the kindness of my heart…"
"Like I said, you don't have to force yourself to hang out with me…"
"Anyway, change your character! This time I'll use Chizuru-san!"
"Takeya…"
"I'm begging you, Haruki. You can handle a handicap like that, right?"
"Gh… mh, gr… What the…!"
"Gr… Ah, shit… No, wait!"
"…I know, people who speak while playing reek of beginner."
"Can't be helped, you really are a beginner after all."
"You were a beginner too just a minute ago! How the hell did you manage to master those super difficult combos!?"
"I wonder how myself… I've become incapable of everything I used to do with ease, yet…"
"…Come to think of it, I wonder if the girls are enjoying their girls' night out."
"…I wouldn't know."
"Well, we're not gonna lose to them. Let's make our boys' night out just as fun! Now time for round 21!"
"…You never learn, do you?"
"On top of that I'm as handsome as they come. They say God never gives any one person more than one blessing, but that's just superstition."
"Hey, hey, how about this place?"
"Atara hot springs… the Izu peninsula, huh?"
The girls' night out was also a sight to behold, with enough food and drink to fill everyone's bellies, and enough talk to exhaust everyone's throats.
However, when Tomo spread out a travel agency catalog on the table, our energy was reinvigorated in an instant.
"Yeah, that sounds pretty good. Izu isn't that far away."
"I'm pretty sure it's the hot springs that caught your attention, Setsuna, not Izu."
"…What's wrong with that?"
"Nothing at all! Hot springs are great. You can just sit there and relax like an old lady… It's amazing!"
"Come to think of it, I don't think we've gone on a trip together since university.
Although unlike then, there's a third wheel coming along."
"I'm so excited. An alumni meeting of former Miss Houjou winners.
Although there's a girl who didn't even get nominated coming along."
"I never had any interest in that stuff!"
"Setsuna never had any interest either, right? And yet she got chosen three years in a row. How did that happen, I wonder?"
"That's enough, you two!
Alright, Arata hot springs it is then! No men allowed whatsoever."
"No computers or cell phones either!"
"Time to flee this cruel world and jump into a life of nothing but alcohol and sleep!"
"Even if there's a beach right in front of us, we'll swim in the hot springs!"
"What, no way. No way I'm doing that."
"We can't just swim in the bath."
"Awww…"
"Oh, but Setsuna… will you be okay? You know…"
"A single night out should be fine. I'll set aside the time. Worst case scenario, I'll ask Takeya for a favor like I did today. Forgive me, Io."
"Huh, why are you bringing me into this?"
"Don't say that. It's because of things like this that you two just keep on…"
"Hey, Setsuna…
"What's that supposed to mean…?"
"But you'll really be okay, right? We can't have you getting worried and going home halfway through, you know?"
"It's okay, I'll get someone else to take care of him. …I realized, just recently."
"Realized what?"
"That unless I enjoy my own life to the fullest, I can't put a smile on his face."
"Setsuna…"
"Besides, I'll only worry Haruki-kun further if I don't show him that I'm having fun."
"God, that annoying part of you is the only thing that hasn't changed over the years."
"So you two don't have to worry that much. Don't hesitate to invite me from now on."
"Are you sure?"
"Yeah, this isn't just for his sake. I think it's also for my… for everyone's sake."
"I guess you're right. What's the point of life without a bit of fun? Even being together with loved ones can get draining otherwise."
"…Yeah, you're right."
No…
I'd be fine with that. I'd be fine with just being together.
But he…
"I'm not going to sacrifice anything. I mean, I want to be happy with everyone.
"You didn't have any fun with us in the past, though."
"Even now she's totally the indoorsy type. She'd never come along unless it's about Kitahara-san or a hot spring."
"Hey, don't make fun of me… I'm trying to be serious here."
"My bad, my bad. Go on."
"As I was about to say, I'll of course never stop loving Haruki-kun either. I think this is something I have to do in order to remain by his side."
"I know you're being serious, but how am I supposed to react when you're going all starry eyed for your boyfriend?"
"I'm sorry, but let me get amorous at least a little bit."
Because no matter how much I struggle, I can never beat her.
Since I can't beat her, I can't use the same methods as her. I can only do what I am capable of, and do it to my utmost.
…No, my only choice is to carry through, without doing my utmost.
"In that case, Setsuna… Um, If you got an invitation to do a live concert… would you do it?"
"Yeah, perhaps. If I have the time, I guess I'd like to."
"R-Really!? You're not quitting singing?"
"No, I'll never quit. I love it, after all."
"S-Setsuna…"
That's right, I'll never quit. I'm too greedy to ever quit.
"Anyway that's how things stand, so let's wrap up here and head to the after-party karaoke! Okay?"
"Ah…"
"…I think we'll sit this one out."
Unlike her, I'm incapable of throwing everything away for his sake…
"You little… Arg… grr… Alright, this time I'll…!"
"Booyah! Finally did the combo!"
"…Hey, Takeya."
"What's up? Don't talk to me when I'm winning. You tryin' to distract me so I'll make a mistake or something?"
"What should I do?"
"I mean my life from here on out, my job, Setsuna… What am I supposed to do?"
"Never thought I'd live to see the day when you'd ask me for advice. I wish the two of us from seven years ago could be around to hear this."
"Takeya…"
"From the very first day we met you began telling me what to do. You'd lecture me for hours, days even, until I finally agreed."
"I'm such an idiot. I never knew how clueless I was."
"I always demand that everyone else is at their best, yet when it comes to myself, I just go with the flow without deciding anything.
"But it was still your choice, even if you believe you were just going with the flow."
"Takeya…"
"That's why you're here right now. There were many other paths ahead of you, but you still remain here."
"But what comfort is that, if the choice I made was the wrong one?"
"There's no value in this path if I've betrayed Setsuna, and abandoned Kazusa…"
"Yet despite that, I still can't let go of Setsuna. I'm still piling on more sins. How can that ever be forgiven?"
"Are you saying that if a person makes the wrong choice once, they don't deserve forgiveness ever? That can't be right."
"It wasn't just once… I did it over and over… at every turn…!"
"To begin with, people have the hardest time understanding themselves over anyone else.
"To sum things up, the stuff you kept telling me was right all along… More right than my own judgment, at least."
"That's precisely why I need you to tell me this time… What am I supposed to do…?"
"You've gotta decide for yourself. Don't ask me."
"…Just so you know, I'm not talking about right now. The choice you'll make is a bit further down the line."
"And when is that…? When in the world is that…?"
"Lemme see… I guess it'll be when you can trust that your decision will be the fruit of all your hesitation and worry."
"…Trust that I was hesitating? That sounds weird."
"Yeah, I suppose it's a bit weird."
"Hey, Haruki."
"Hm?"
"When that time comes… When you've hesitated and worried enough, and when you're ready to make a choice… talk to me first, okay?"
"Takeya…"
"If it's your choice, then I won't say a word about it… is what I'll absolutely never say. I'll tell you exactly what to do like you used to with me."
"…Please do."
"Yeah, leave it to me."
"I'm sorry, Takeya. I'm really sorry…"
"Save those words for the person who actually deserves to hear them, when you're back to your usual self."
"And once that baptism is over and done with, I'll be next.
"Thank god! We made it in time for the last train."
"Ah, my throat's all sore. I hope it'll get better by Monday, at least."
"That's only because you tried going toe-to-toe with Setsuna. Had you just let her sing by herself, we would've been done in two hours."
"But that's lame. I gotta show off the fruits of my own voice training, you know?"
"Aren't you forgetting the purpose of today's outing?"
"We're celebrating my first employment, right?"
"Oh what's the problem? I'm telling you, Setsuna will shed a lot more stress if we all have fun together."
"I sure pray so. Setsuna did look like she was having a bit of fun, I guess."
"You're the one who's being too considerate, Mizusawa-san. If only you could show that same kind of consideration to Iizuka-san as well…"
"Don't segway the conversation into something completely unrelated! I'm not taking the bait, so give it up."
"Tsk!"
"Hmph."
"Hey."
"Hm?"
"Are you still against it?"
"Obviously."
"Do you hate him that much now? Haruki, I mean…"
"I don't hate him. I just can't forgive him."
"I can't even think of a scenario where I'd forgive him… Changing his mind as he pleases, hesitating as he pleases, breaking down as he pleases."
"Perhaps… he didn't change his mind."
"Even if I discard my personal feelings on the matter, Kitahara-san right now is nothing but a burden on Setsuna."
"Of course, Setsuna would be livid if she heard me say that, so I'll keep this just between you and me."
"Try being a bit considerate of my mental state as well."
"So how about you, Mizusawa-san? Are you still able to forgive Kitahara-san after what he did?"
"I can't forgive him… but I want to remain his friend."
"Our friendship goes further back than Setsuna and I. I know that he's living his life in earnest, always trying to be honest."
"But that doesn't mean…"
"Besides, I can understand Touma-san's feelings a little as well. It's just that… her feelings were more powerful than I ever could have imagined."
"But the strength of those feelings was what led to this whole mess."
"Above all, Setsuna would never want to see those two punished for that."
"In any case, you can just stay the way you are. Stay by Setsuna's side and keep on supporting only her as you always have."
"Well, I guess Setsuna's completely hopeless without me anyway."
"I'm sure Takeya will continue taking Haruki's side. I think that balance is exactly what we need."
"What about you, Mizusawa-san?"
"I'll reserve my judgment for now."
"That's called being indecisive."
"But I really don't know yet. Whether Setsuna truly is forcing herself, or whether she actually…"
"She's obviously forcing herself."
"…You might be right, but I don't know if she's reaching her limit, or if she's still able to push further."
"I keep telling you, that's…"
"Even if she is at her limit, I still have to think about it. Whether I should force those two apart, or help them get back together like Setsuna wants."
"I don't know. I have an idea or two, but I still don't have any confidence in them."
"Seriously, whenever it's about men and women, your ability to decide completely evaporates."
"I don't wanna hear that from…"
"Ah, I'm sorry."
"Yes, yes… We just wrapped up."
"I see… Everything went smoothly today then. Good work."
"Yeah, alright then… huh? You mean right now?"
"…Fine, in front of the station then."
"Sorry, something just came up. I gotta go."
"A date?"
"Of course not, we're just going for a bite to eat."
"But you've had loads of food and drinks tonight."
"All that singing got me a little hungry again."
"And you're leaving, knowing that you'll miss the last train?"
"I could catch the first morning train if I pass the time a little."
"Isn't that what they call a date?"
"Not even close. See ya."
"Ah…"
"These two are annoying too!"
